episodes.name: Meet the Metal Men
episodes.overviewEn: Will Magnus constructs the Metal Men.

episodes.name: Three Laws of Robotics
episodes.overviewEn: Will Magnus tries to teach the Metal Men the Three Laws of Robotics.

episodes.name: Identity Crisis
episodes.overviewEn: The Metal Men must face a threat despite their heads switched between each other's bodies.

episodes.name: Cash for Gold
episodes.overviewEn: The Metal Men attempt to earn some money to pay for the damage they caused, only to inevitably make things worse.

episodes.name: Metal Men vs. Chemo
episodes.overviewEn: The Metal Men battle the toxin-spewing giant robot, Chemo, in their usual ineffectual way.
